interpretation.no_new_photo: Matched initial prompt/tools; access-permission intervention also changes request feedback.
interpretation.request_strata: Selected by the adaptive policy; descriptive, not randomized subgroups.
interpretation.restore_vs_adaptive: Scripted restoration uses a terminal prompt and finish-only tools; not a pure action-selection intervention.
interpretation.uncertainty: Family sampling only; one model-training seed and one random-order seed; unreviewed labels are not validated by bootstrap.

scope: Agreement with unreviewed source-derived labels; not grounded accuracy or human-reviewed sufficiency.
